notes: PAP reference G39/0262. Whole four-room apartment offered by a private owner near central Compiègne. The complete live advert describes a bright 77 m2 apartment on the top floor of a maintained quiet residence, with a double living room opening to a south-facing balcony, two south-facing bedrooms and the stated possibility of creating a third bedroom. It exposes parquet flooring, triple exposure, views over Parc Teinturier, collective gas heating, monthly coproperty charges of EUR 300, and 2025 taxe fonciere of EUR 1,768. Parking spaces are available at the foot of the residence and are not represented as a private included lot. The stated EUR 236,000 is the full apartment price. The source contains no tenant, lease, occupied-sale, delayed-vacancy, managed-residence or special ownership wording. PAP exposed 11 property photos and a publication date of 1 October 2026. No numbered floor, lift, energy class or other unexposed fact is inferred.
